import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyTorusExterior

/-!
# Homotopy invariance of the exterior cup isomorphism

Naturality and the cohomology equivalence induced by a homotopy equivalence
transport bijectivity of the actual exterior cup comparison. In particular,
the finite-torus calculation applies to any space homeomorphic to that torus.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X Y : TopCat}

/-- Bijectivity of the exterior cup comparison is invariant under homotopy
equivalence. -/
theorem singularCohomologyExteriorPower_bijective_of_homotopyEquiv
    (e : ContinuousMap.HomotopyEquiv X Y) (n : ℕ)
    (hY : Function.Bijective (singularCohomologyExteriorPower Y n)) :
    Function.Bijective (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X n) := by
  let f := TopCat.ofHom e.toFun
  have hmap : Function.Surjective
      (exteriorPower.map n (singularCohomologyPullback f 1)) :=
    exteriorPower.map_surjective (singularCohomologyHomotopyEquiv e 1).surjective
  refine ⟨?_, singularCohomologyExteriorPower_surjective_of_pullback f n
    (singularCohomologyHomotopyEquiv e n).surjective hY.2⟩
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hmap x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hmap y
  apply congrArg (exteriorPower.map n (singularCohomologyPullback f 1))
  apply hY.1
  apply (singularCohomologyHomotopyEquiv e n).injective
  change singularCohomologyPullback f n (singularCohomologyExteriorPower Y n a) =
    singularCohomologyPullback f n (singularCohomologyExteriorPower Y n b)
  exact (LinearMap.congr_fun (singularCohomologyExteriorPower_naturality f n) a).trans
    (hxy.trans (LinearMap.congr_fun
      (singularCohomologyExteriorPower_naturality f n) b).symm)

/-- The canonical exterior cup map is bijective on every space homeomorphic
to a finite product of circles. The homeomorphism is used only in the proof. -/
theorem singularCohomologyExteriorPower_bijective_of_torusHomeomorph
    {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] {d : ℕ}
    (e : X ≃ₜ (Fin d → Circle)) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (singularCohomologyExteriorPower (TopCat.of X) n) :=
  singularCohomologyExteriorPower_bijective_of_homotopyEquiv
    (X := TopCat.of X) (Y := TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) e.toHomotopyEquiv n
    (torusCohomologyExteriorPower_bijective d n)

end Mumford.Analytic
